# Database identity correction

The Awtsmoos reveals identity through the actual vessel of data; Awtsmoos.com must not invent a Heichel name in presentation code.

## Evidence

The live local DosDB row at `/social/heichelos/ikar/info` was a device-transfer placeholder:

- `name: Ikar`
- `title: Ikar`
- description: `The root Heichel restored after device transfer.`
- `dayuh.restoredAfterDeviceTransfer: true`

The user supplied the canonical identity: `The Entire Torah` and explicitly required the UI to read the database rather than fabricate it.

## Repair

- Backed up the placeholder row to `/tmp/awtsmoos-ikar-info-before-entire-torah.json`.
- Repaired the database record to `name/title: The Entire Torah`.
- Removed only the exact transfer-placeholder description and marker.
- Preserved id, author, createdAt, and all non-placeholder data.
- Source presentation will now render database identity directly and will not special-case an Ikar display name.

## NEXT_ACTION

Rewrite the fallback/enhancer so database name/title is sovereign, strengthen the futuristic hero without invented copy, simplify Community composer repetition, then test and deploy both code and production data repair.
